title: using live context to eliminate flickering
body:
hey,

cool visualization! i got dizzy with the flickering when it was redrawing so i put in a live context, so it looks smooth now.
author: peppermintcoding

comments.body: tested it locally. and flicker doesn't seem to be there. merging it.

title: Included support to CUDA and CLI parameter to disable CUDA.
body:
Added support to CUDA and refactored Rich with live update.
This will make the UI more fluid and with less flickering/refresh
